notes.title: New DLC, Linux and Languages
notes.content:
Hello,

I have now launched the new "Collector's Edition" DLC for Sisyphus Reborn. The main intent of this is for players who want to keep the game in their collection after uninstalling. There are no new achievements with this DLC, to ensure that all players can still 100% complete the game with just the free version.

It includes:

- Extended version of the game soundtrack, with 5 new tracks 
- A 10 page pdf book of the original sketches used in the game
- 4 short deleted scenes not included in the original game (total gameplay ~ 5 minutes).

There is also a Linux version available now (both free game and DLC). Thanks to Jarl Gullberg for volunteering to help make this happen! If anyone needs help porting games to Linux, get in touch at jarl.gullberg@gmail.com

Lastly, I'm excited to announce there are translations in the works for both a Spanish and French version of the game. These will hopefully both be released later this year.

Thanks for playing,
Edwin

notes.title: Thank you + new DLC
notes.content:
First of all I just want to say thank you to everyone who has played the game and left feedback - it's so great to see this game finding an audience on Steam!

A few players have given feedback about the inability to keep the game in your Steam library after uninstalling it. It looks like this is how free games work on Steam - because they're not "purchased" they don't actually get added to your collection.

For this reason, I'm planning to release a new "Collector's Edition" DLC for those wishing to add the game to their permanent collection. I always planned for this to be a free game, so this DLC would be entirely optional, and not change the gameplay in any way - it would include additional material like unreleased music tracks and alternate versions, scans of the original artwork, and so on.

If anyone has any thoughts on this, or something you'd want to see included in the DLC, please let me know.

Once again, thanks for playing!
- Edwin
